title: ID0422206-DC/Si-D/AT-[MP / S7 170003961] FW Update
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
I know there is already a Ticket for this Charger but this this one is only for the update. The Rollout for FW5 was started last week. Till now i cant start the update and if i try the rollout, i get the message that its already initiated.
Root cause: Hawkbit.conf missing
Solution: Upload config file from S3 to charger via SSH
